desc:
🐝 Welcome to Steal a Bee Egg!

How To Play:
🏃 TRAIN your speed on treadmills to outrun guard bees!
🥚 STEAL eggs from the guard bees... Or other players... AND RACE HOME!
🐣 HATCH bees that earn you 💵 cash every second
🌦️ WEATHER EVENTS that mutate eggs for huge cash multipliers!

🎮Supports Desktop, Phone, Tablet and Controller players!
